MemoryConfigs.Name: Charm Aura Zone Transition Fix - Hook
MemoryConfigs.Description: Hooks call to sub_1402EC080 at 2A041F inside sub_1402A01F0. Replaces E8 rel32 CALL with E9 rel32 JMP to cave at 149B2B1.

MemoryConfigs.Name: Charm Aura Zone Transition Fix - Cave
MemoryConfigs.Description: Cave at 149B2B1 (253 bytes). Saves r13=pGame, r12=pUnit. Calls stolen sub_2EC080. Gets pInventory via sub_208330. Walks linked list: IsMatchingType(pItem, 0x0D) for ITEMTYPE_CHARM, checks [pItemData+B8h]==3 (inventory page, excludes cube=6/stash=7), checks [pItemData+18h] & 0x10 (IDENTIFIED flag). Collects qualifying charms (max 32). For each: NULLs [pItem+88h]+0 (pStatListEx->pUnit) then calls sub_1E5EA0(pUnit, pItem, 1) triggering case 151 STAT_ITEM_AURA -> PERIODICSTATS re-registration. Returns to 2A0424.

MemoryConfigs.Name: Cube Transmute Crash Fix - Hook
MemoryConfigs.Description: Hooks sub_140BE94B0 (the client-side transmute packet builder). Redirects to cave at 149B3B0 which counts cube items via sub_140208330 inventory walk and aborts the transmute if count > 100. Prevents crash from 5*N+8 byte packet exceeding the 512-byte cap in sub_14010E710's dedup buffer (asserts and exits at >=512 bytes, which manifests as a deferred crash in NVIDIA NGX during process teardown). No legitimate recipe takes >100 inputs; this is purely a misclick guard for cubes used as bulk storage. Stolen byte: mov [rsp+8], rbx.

MemoryConfigs.Name: Cube Transmute Crash Fix - Cave
MemoryConfigs.Description: Cave at 149B3B0 (167 bytes). On entry to sub_140BE94B0: gets pPlayer via sub_14006B050(dword_141D442D8), gets pInventory via sub_140208330. Walks pInventory linked list (chain through pItemData+0xB0). For each item with unitType==4 and pItemData->pageByte==3 (cube page), increments counter. If count > 100, returns immediately (transmute aborted). Otherwise re-executes stolen byte (mov [rsp+8], rbx) and jumps back to BE94B5 to let original transmute proceed. Stack: sub rsp, 0x28 for shadow space + alignment around the two calls; restored before ret or jmp back.

MemoryConfigs.Name: Cube Throw Crash Fix - Hook
MemoryConfigs.Description: Hooks sub_14010E930 (cube-drop packet builder, packet ID 0x22). Only ever called from sub_1400D35B0's actual drop send-site, so does NOT fire on movement/polling paths. Redirects to cave at 149B444 which checks (r9-r8)/16 = item count and aborts the packet send if count > 70. Prevents crash from 7*N+17 byte packet exceeding the 512-byte cap in sub_14010E710's dedup buffer (asserts and exits at >=512 bytes). Stolen bytes (9): push rbx (with REX 40 prefix), sub rsp, 0x750. Replaces previous failed cube-throw guard at sub_1400D35B0 entry which incorrectly fired on every-frame polling calls.

MemoryConfigs.Name: Cube Throw Crash Fix - Cave
MemoryConfigs.Description: Cave at 149B444 (33 bytes). Computes item count from r9-r8 (param registers a4-a3, the array end and start pointers, each item is 16 bytes / __m128i). If count > 70, returns 0 immediately (sub_14010E930 returns int; 0 = no error from packet send wrapper's perspective). Otherwise re-executes stolen prolog (push rbx; sub rsp, 0x750) and jumps back to 10E939. Massively simpler than previous attempt because we hook at the packet-send level rather than the cube-throw handler entry, eliminating the every-frame polling problem entirely.

MemoryConfigs.Name: Charm Dedup - Hook IsCharmUsable
MemoryConfigs.Description: Replaces 'mov eax, 1' at 0x2005C2 (success exit of ITEMS_IsCharmUsable, RVA 0x200540) with E9 jmp to dedup cave at 0x149B467. Returns to 0x2005C7.

MemoryConfigs.Name: Charm Dedup - Cave (IsCharmUsable)
MemoryConfigs.Description: Cave at 0x149B467 (244 bytes). Saves r12/r14/r15. Returns 1 if pItem->pItemData->dwQuality (+0x00) != 7 (UNIQUE). Else reads my unique row from pItemData+0x34 into r14d, gets pInventory via sub_208330, walks linked list via [pItemData+0xB0]. For each other item: must be UNIT_ITEM, valid pItemData, dwQuality==7, nInvPage(+0x55)==0, no IFLAG_BROKEN(0x100)/IFLAG_NOEQUIP(0x4000), same dwUniqueRow. Tie-break: cmp r12,rbx; jb .fail (lower pItem address loses). On .ok (winner): clears bit 0x80000000 in [pItemData+0x18] and returns 1. On .fail (loser): sets bit 0x80000000 in [pItemData+0x18] (loser marker, read by sub_9FFF0 cave for red render), then loads pStatListEx from [pItem+0x88] and calls sub_1E4300 to expire/unmerge stats from owner before returning 0. Returns to 0x2005C7.

MemoryConfigs.Name: Charm Dedup - Hook Renderer (red tint for losers)
MemoryConfigs.Description: Hooks renderer sub_1401BD8C0 at 0x1BDB31 (right after call to CheckRequirements). Replaces 5 bytes (test eax,eax + first 3 bytes of jz to red_path 0x1BDBFA) with E9 jmp to cave at 0x149B55B. Cave replicates original test/jz, then additionally checks bit 0x80000000 in pItem->pItemData->dwItemFlags ([rdi+10h]+18h - rdi=pItem at this point, callee-saved across CheckRequirements call). If marker bit set (charm dedup loser), jumps to red render path 0x1BDBFA. Otherwise jumps to 0x1BDB39 to continue normal predicate chain. Scoped to this single renderer function — no global side effects on pickup/tooltip/etc.

MemoryConfigs.Name: Charm Dedup - Cave (Renderer red tint)
MemoryConfigs.Description: Cave at 0x149B55B (44 bytes). Entry: eax = CheckRequirements result, rdi = pItem. Replicates original 'test eax,eax / jz red' (jumps to 0x1BDBFA if requirements failed). If passed, dereferences pItemData via [rdi+10h] and checks bit 0x80000000 in dwItemFlags. Set => jumps to red path 0x1BDBFA (loser visual). Clear => jumps to 0x1BDB39 to continue normal predicate chain. Cave uses no stack, no register saves needed.

MemoryConfigs.Name: Charge Missile-on-Hit Hook
MemoryConfigs.Description: Hooks SrvDo067_Charge phase-1 hit branch at 386044 (the displaced 5-byte 'mov eax, 1' before 'jmp loc_385C18'). Redirects to cave at 149B589 which: (1) filters pTarget->dwUnitType == 1 (UNIT_MONSTER) at [r12], (2) allocates 0x90 stack frame with D2MissileStrc at [rsp+0x20], (3) zeros struct via rep stosq, (4) calls SKILLS_GetProgressiveSkillMissileId (2C5D50) with rcx=pUnit(rbx), edx=nSkillId([rsp+0xD0]), bails on negative result, (5) reads pTarget->pPath ([r12+0x38]) and pUnit->pPath ([rbx+0x38]) for X(+0x02 word) and Y(+0x06 word) coords, bails if either path is null, (6) computes through-target trajectory: nTargetX = 2*targetX - unitX, nTargetY = 2*targetY - unitY, (7) populates D2MissileStrc fields: dwFlags=0x21(+0x00), pOwner=pUnit(+0x08), nMissile(+0x20), nX=targetX(+0x2C), nY=targetY(+0x30), nTargetX(+0x3C), nTargetY(+0x40), nSkill(+0x68), nSkillLevel(+0x6C), (8) calls MISSILES_CreateMissileFromParams (3151A0) with rcx=pGame(rdi), rdx=&struct, (9) restores stack, sets eax=1, jumps back to 386049. Live regs at hook: rbx=pUnit, r12=pTarget, rdi=pGame; nSkillId at [rsp+0x40], nSkillLevel at [rsp+0x48] (post-cave-adjustment +0xD0/+0xD8). Missile spawned per skills.txt SrvMissile column (charge has no aurastate progression so SrvMissileA is used).

MemoryConfigs.Name: Smite Calc5 Multi-Hit Hook
MemoryConfigs.Description: Hooks SrvDo150_Smite at 383ABE (the call to SUNITDMG_AllocCombat at the end of the function). Replaces the 5-byte call instruction with jmp to cave at 149B69A. Cave evaluates Calc5 from skills.txt ([r15+0x168] where r15=pSkillsTxtRecord) via SKILLS_EvaluateSkillFormula (6D08C0) with args (rcx=rsi=pUnit, edx=Calc5, r8d=ebx=nSkillId, r9d=r12d=nSkillLevel), clamps result to >=1, stores hit count at [rsp+0x28], then loops calling SUNITDMG_AllocCombat (3292B0) N times with args (rcx=rdi=pGame, rdx=rsi=pUnit, r8=r14=pTarget, r9=&damage at [rsp+0x70], [rsp+0x20] byte=0x80=nSrcDam). Each iteration re-applies the same damage struct, giving N independent damage events (N x lifesteal procs, N x on-hit triggers, etc.). Live regs preserved across calls: rdi=pGame, rsi=pUnit, rbx=nSkillId, r12d=nSkillLevel, r14=pTarget, r15=pSkillsTxtRecord (all non-volatile in MS x64 ABI). After loop, jumps back to 383AC3 (mov r13d, 1) to continue normal function epilogue. Calc field offsets in D2R D2SkillsTxt: Calc1=+0x158, Calc2=+0x15C, Calc3=+0x160, Calc4=+0x164, Calc5=+0x168, Calc6=+0x16C.

MemoryConfigs.Name: Smite Holy Shield damage display - state lookup hook
MemoryConfigs.Description: Patches the descdam=10 handler at sub_1AD860 (RVA 1ADA17) to look up state cast by skill 546 instead of vanilla skill 117 (Holy Shield). The original code at 1ADA17 walks the unit's statlist via cmp word ptr [rax], 0x75 / jnz, finding the state whose source skill is 117 to compute Smite's character-sheet bonus damage display. Since 546 (0x222) doesn't fit in the original 4-byte cmp r/m16, imm8 sign-extended encoding, we replace the 6-byte block (cmp + jnz, 1ADA17..1ADA1C) with a jmp to cave at 149B7B2 plus a NOP. The cave performs the equivalent comparison with the full 16-bit immediate (cmp word ptr [rax], 0x222) and dispatches: jne to 1ADA23 (walk to next state in linked list) or fallthrough/jmp to 1ADA1D (state matched, proceed with damage calc). Result: character sheet now reads skill 546's damage data for the bonus display instead of skill 117. Original: 66 83 38 75 75 06 = cmp word [rax], 0x75 / jnz short.

MemoryConfigs.Name: Smite Holy Shield damage display - state lookup cave
MemoryConfigs.Description: Cave for Smite Holy Shield damage display redirect (paired with hook at 1ADA17). Located at 149B7B2 (16 bytes). Performs cmp word ptr [rax], 0x222 (546, custom skill replacing Holy Shield 117 for bonus damage display), then jne to 1ADA23 (continue statlist walk) or jmp to 1ADA1D (matched, proceed with damage calc). See companion hook description for full context.

MemoryConfigs.Name: Charge srvdofunc - damage conversion uses Calc5 instead of Calc4
MemoryConfigs.Description: Patches the Calc4 read at SrvDo067_Charge (385F10) to read Calc5 instead. The instruction `mov eax, [r13+0x164]` reads dwCalc[3] (Calc4) which is then passed to SKILLS_EvaluateSkillFormula and used as damage.dwConvPct (elemental damage conversion percentage). Changing the displacement byte from 0x64 to 0x68 redirects the read to dwCalc[4] (Calc5, offset 0x168). All other behavior — bounds check, formula evaluation, conv pct assignment — remains identical. The instruction encoding is `41 8B 85 [disp32]` = mov eax, [r13+disp32]; the disp32 is little-endian, so we patch the lowest-significance byte at 385F13 from 0x64 to 0x68.

MemoryConfigs.Name: AST_Multiplication site hook (formula evaluator overflow fix)
MemoryConfigs.Description: sub_1406D08C0 case AST_Multiplication. Replaces 32-bit `imul ecx,edx` + `jmp loc_6D0F14` (8 bytes) with `jmp <cave>` + 3 NOPs. Cave at RVA 149B7C4 sign-extends both operands to 64-bit, performs imul rcx,rdx, saturates result to [INT32_MIN, INT32_MAX], then jumps back to RVA 6D0F14. Fixes int32 overflow in skill formula evaluation that affects both LCS display and server-side stat assignment.

MemoryConfigs.Name: AST_Power site hook (formula evaluator overflow fix)
MemoryConfigs.Description: sub_1406D08C0 case AST_Power loop body. Replaces `imul ecx,r8d` + `sub rdx,1` (8 bytes) with `jmp <cave>` + 3 NOPs. Cave at RVA 149B7F5 performs 64-bit imul, saturates to int32, re-emits `sub rdx,1`, jumps back to the loop's `jnz` at RVA 6D0D8C. Companion to the Multiplication patch.

MemoryConfigs.Name: AST evaluator saturation cave (Multiplication + Power)
MemoryConfigs.Description: Cave bytes at RVA 149B7C4. Two adjacent code blocks: [+0]   AST_Multiplication saturating multiply (49 bytes); [+31] AST_Power saturating multiply with re-emit of the overwritten `sub rdx,1` (53 bytes). MemoryConfigs.Description: Cave at RVA 149BA70. 12 identical blocks computing (ebx * ecx) / 100 with int32 saturation. Each block is independent (different rejoin RVA) since rejoin targets the appropriate 'add ebx, edx' for each branch. Total 804 bytes.

MemoryConfigs.Name: Bow/missile damage 32-bit imul overflow fix - hook
MemoryConfigs.Description: Hook at RVA 3C65B6. Original 19 bytes: imul ecx,[r14]; imul ecx; sar edx,5; mov eax,edx; shr eax,1Fh; add edx,eax; add [r14],edx. r14 = damage_struct + 0x1C (physical damage component). ecx = damage bonus percent. The 32-bit imul ecx,[r14] overflows for high damage values (e.g. 50M raw * 100% bonus = 5B which exceeds INT32_MAX), wrapping to negative. Replaces with JMP to cave at RVA 149BD96 which performs equivalent math in 64-bit with INT32 saturation. Returns to RVA 3C65C9 (next instruction after original add [r14], edx).

MemoryConfigs.Name: Bow/missile damage 32-bit imul overflow fix - cave
MemoryConfigs.Description: Cave at RVA 149BD96. 70 bytes. Performs (ecx * *r14) / 100 in 64-bit with INT32 saturation, then adds low 32 bits to *r14. Algorithm: movsxd rcx,ecx; movsxd rax,[r14]; imul rcx,rax (64-bit); rax=100; cqo; idiv rcx; mov rdx,rax; clamp rdx to [INT32_MIN, INT32_MAX]; add [r14],edx. Returns via E9 jmp back to RVA 3C65C9.

MemoryConfigs.Name: Bow/missile damage 32-bit imul overflow fix - hook
MemoryConfigs.Description: Hook at RVA 3C65B6. Original 19 bytes are: imul ecx,[r14]; imul ecx (with 0x51EB851F); sar edx,5; mov eax,edx; shr eax,1Fh; add edx,eax; add [r14],edx. This computes ecx*(*r14)/100 with rounding then adds to *r14. r14 = damage_struct + 0x1C (physical damage component). ecx = damage bonus percent. The 32-bit imul ecx,[r14] overflows int32 for high damage values (e.g. 50M raw * 100 = 5B exceeds INT32_MAX), wrapping to negative which then gets divided and added, producing negative or wrong damage components. Replaces with JMP to cave at RVA 149BD96 which performs equivalent math in 64-bit with INT32 saturation. Returns to RVA 3C65C9.

MemoryConfigs.Name: Bow/missile damage 32-bit imul overflow fix - cave
MemoryConfigs.Description: Cave at RVA 149BD96. 70 bytes. Computes (ecx * *r14) / 100 in 64-bit with INT32 saturation then adds low 32 bits to *r14. Disassembly: movsxd rcx,ecx; movsxd rax,[r14]; imul rcx,rax (64-bit); mov rax,rcx; cqo (sign-extend product to rdx:rax); mov rcx,100; idiv rcx (rax = product/100); mov rdx,rax; clamp rdx to [INT32_MIN, INT32_MAX] via cmp/cmovg/cmovl; add [r14],edx. Returns via 5-byte E9 jmp to RVA 3C65C9.

MemoryConfigs.Name: Skip Exp Loss in Protected Levels - Cave
MemoryConfigs.Description: Cave at 149B5BE. Saves rcx/rdx, calls UNITS_GetRoom on pDefender, walks pRoom+18h->+90h->+1F8h for levelId. Range check 0..255, bitmap lookup (32 bytes for 256 IDs). MemoryConfigs.Name: Multi-Aura per Item - Case 151 Hook
MemoryConfigs.Description: Hook the inlined STAT_ITEM_AURA delete-walk inside sub_2D2B00 (case 151 of the server stat callback dispatcher). Replaces 11 bytes (test r15d,r15d / jz +6 / cmp [rdx+18h],r15d / jnz +8) at 0x2D35F9 with E9 jmp to cave at 0x149B651 + 6 NOPs. Cave adds skill-ID match alongside the itemGUID match so deleting events doesn't wipe other auras' events on the same item. Registers at hook: r15d=itemGUID (customId filter, 0=wildcard for deactivate), r13d=nSkillId (new skill being activated), rdx=current event in walk. Targets: 0x2D3604 (delete-call) or 0x2D360C (continue-loop).

MemoryConfigs.Name: Multi-Aura per Item - Case 151 Cave
MemoryConfigs.Description: Cave at 0x149B651 (27 bytes) for case 151 multi-aura delete-walk hook. Replicates original test r15d/jz wildcard (preserves deactivate-path behavior when itemGUID=0) + cmp [rdx+18h] itemGUID match, ADDS cmp [rdx+1Ch], r13d skill match. Match (itemGUID AND skillID) -> 0x2D3604 (delete event). Wildcard (r15d=0) -> 0x2D3604 (delete all events). Mismatch -> 0x2D360C (continue loop). Without this, three item_aura stats with same itemGUID would mutually wipe each other's PERIODICSTATS events at activation.

MemoryConfigs.Name: Multi-Aura per Item - sub_2999E0 Hook
MemoryConfigs.Description: Hook the periodic re-arm delete-walk inside sub_2999E0 (the indirect-dispatched STAT_ITEM_AURA handler, reached via the fcallback table at .rdata 0x158F560/0x158F7A8). Replaces 9 bytes (test ebx,ebx / jz +5 / cmp [rdx+18h],ebx / jnz +8) at 0x299B79 with E9 jmp to cave at 0x149B66C + 4 NOPs. Parallel to the case-151 patch but for this separate stat-callback path. Registers at hook: ebx=itemGUID, r14d=nSkillId, rdx=current event. Targets: 0x299B82 (delete-call) or 0x299B8A (continue-loop).

MemoryConfigs.Name: Multi-Aura per Item - sub_2999E0 Cave
MemoryConfigs.Description: Cave at 0x149B66C (25 bytes) for sub_2999E0 multi-aura delete-walk hook. Replicates original test ebx/jz wildcard (preserves deactivate-path behavior when itemGUID=0) + cmp [rdx+18h] itemGUID match, ADDS cmp [rdx+1Ch], r14d skill match. Match (itemGUID AND skillID) -> 0x299B82 (delete event). Wildcard (ebx=0) -> 0x299B82 (delete all events). Mismatch -> 0x299B8A (continue loop). r14d holds nSkillId from function entry (movsxd r14, r9d at 0x2999FE). Companion to case-151 patch; sub_2999E0 is the secondary STAT_ITEM_AURA dispatcher reached through the fcallback table, separate from the inlined case 151 in sub_2D2B00.

MemoryConfigs.Name: Multi-Aura per Item - Case 151 Hook (Second Walk)
MemoryConfigs.Description: Hook the SECOND inlined STAT_ITEM_AURA delete-walk inside sub_2D2B00 case 151, located in the (a1+23432) pending-list branch. Replaces 11 bytes (test r15d,r15d / jz +6 / cmp [rdx+18h],r15d / jnz +8) at 0x2D36EA with E9 jmp to cave at 0x149BDDC + 6 NOPs. Without this fix, the FIRST walk patch (at 0x2D35F9) is bypassed in the pending-list code path and same-item co-existing auras get wiped down to the last-processed skill when an item carrying multiple STAT_ITEM_AURA stat entries is equipped. Registers at hook: r15d=itemGUID, r13d=nSkillId, rdx=current event. Targets: 0x2D36F5 (delete) or 0x2D36FD (continue loop).

MemoryConfigs.Name: Multi-Aura per Item - Case 151 Cave (Second Walk)
MemoryConfigs.Description: Cave at 0x149BDDC (27 bytes, in .text end-padding) for case 151 second multi-aura delete-walk hook. Replicates original test r15d/jz wildcard (preserves deactivate-path behavior when itemGUID=0) + cmp [rdx+18h] itemGUID match, ADDS cmp [rdx+1Ch], r13d skill match. Match (itemGUID AND skillID) -> 0x2D36F5 (delete event). Wildcard (r15d=0) -> 0x2D36F5 (delete all events). Mismatch -> 0x2D36FD (continue loop). Companion to the first case-151 walk patch at 0x149B651 - both walks live inside case 151 but in different branches: the first is the normal activation path, this second one runs in the (a1+23432) pending-aura-list re-arm branch that fires on equip.
